reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes daily Ethereum earnings through Infinite Ethereum and requires viewers to deposit at least 0.025 ETH, register, and activate project levels. It presents a participant network with repeated or unlimited return claims, while linking escalating Ethereum amounts and an upgrade step to wallet balances. Although it includes a disclaimer that income is not guaranteed, the described promotional mechanism supports the classification.

citations.quote: In the next few minutes, I will show you how you can earn Ethereum daily using the Infinite Ethereum linear project.
Below you are five places on a single monoline in each level, and there are 12 levels. Each level you purchase is four times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well.
In all of the levels, you get 100% of the payments to your Ethereum wallet from spot 1, 2, 3 and 4. The fifth spot reopens the level again.
it is possible to earn Ethereum even without referring anyone since everyone is on a single linear line network at each level

To get started, you need to install Trust CryptoWallet app on your phone or MetaMask wallet on your PC and deposit enough Ethereum to register and then activate the amount of levels that you want, one by one.

opening.argument: Judge the invitation alongside its express qualification: the speaker says the project is not a get-rich-quick scheme, that income is not guaranteed, and that participants need to put in effort. The instructions also leave participants to choose how many levels to activate. Those details make this a promotion of a paid opportunity with stated uncertainty, not a promise that paying in will produce a particular return. The presentation deserves scrutiny, but its strongest earnings language should not erase the qualification the speaker actually gives.

citations.quote: infinite aetherium is not a get-rich-quick scheme income is not guaranteed you need to put in the effort
then activate the amount of levels that you want, one by one.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening treats the level schedule as proof of a promised return. But a description of what each purchased level can generate does not establish that any viewer will receive those payments. Nor does the wallet setup instruction itself promise a payout. The speaker explicitly says income is not guaranteed, a qualification the opening acknowledges but gives too little weight.

citations.quote: Each level you purchase is four times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well.
income is not guaranteed

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The disclaimer does not change what viewers are being urged to buy. The speaker recommends starting with four to six levels and says more activated levels mean more Ethereum earned. Payments are described as coming from positions in those purchased levels, with the fifth position reopening the level. That is a participant-payment mechanism, not merely an uncertain return on an ordinary purchase.

citations.quote: The more levels you activate, the more Ethereum you can earn.
It is recommended to start with at least four to six levels.
you get 100% of the payments to your Ethereum wallet from spot 1, 2, 3 and 4. The fifth spot reopens the level again.

opening.argument: Much of this presentation explains an operating model: it asks how the project works, describes five places on a monoline at each of twelve levels, and explains which positions pay and which reopen a level. It also discusses a smart contract that executes the program automatically. A judge can read these passages as a demonstration of the proposed system rather than evidence that the video verifies anyone's earnings. Explaining the mechanics, even in promotional language, does not itself establish that the described payments occurred.

citations.quote: How does infinite ethereum linear project work? Below you are five places on a single monoline in each level, and there are 12 levels.
In all of the levels, you get 100% of the payments to your Ethereum wallet from spot 1, 2, 3 and 4. The fifth spot reopens the level again.
smart contract technology that executes the program automatically in a decentralized way.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening accurately identifies the deposit and level activation instructions, but those instructions appear within an explanation of how the proposed system operates. Its quotes describe projected payments from positions; they do not independently show that those payments happened or that the speaker verified the system's claims. The video's explicit question, 'How does infinite ethereum linear project work?', supports reading the detailed sequence as a demonstration.

citations.quote: deposit enough Ethereum to register and then activate the amount of levels that you want, one by one.
How does infinite ethereum linear project work?

true_side_reply.rebuttal: This is not a detached demonstration. The speaker tells viewers they can earn Ethereum daily, recommends buying at least four to six levels, and closes with instructions to deposit Ethereum, register, and activate levels. The explanation serves that invitation. Whether the claimed payouts have occurred is not the decisive point: the video promotes paying into a position-based earnings network.

citations.quote: I will show you how you can earn Ethereum daily using the Infinite Ethereum linear project.
It is recommended to start with at least four to six levels.
deposit enough Ethereum to register and then activate the amount of levels that you want, one by one.

opening.argument: The distinction here is between a required recruiting chain and a promotion that describes shared network activity. The speaker expressly says participants can earn without referring anyone and depicts everyone on a single line. The payment description names positions in levels, while the setup instructions call for a wallet the participant controls, registration, and chosen level activation. On this record, the judge should not infer a requirement to recruit people or surrender wallet keys. The video may be aggressively promotional, but those absent requirements matter when assessing its mechanism.

citations.quote: it is possible to earn Ethereum even without referring anyone since everyone is on a single linear line network at each level
you get 100% of the payments to your Ethereum wallet from spot 1, 2, 3 and 4.
stored in their personal Ethereum wallet, which they control the private keys.
deposit enough Ethereum to register and then activate the amount of levels that you want, one by one.

rebuttal.rebuttal: The opening cites the absence of necessary personal referrals but then treats network positions as though they establish such a requirement. The speaker says earnings are possible without referring anyone. It also describes payments going to members' own wallets, not a request to hand over private keys. The quoted deposit instruction establishes a purchase requirement, but does not by itself establish compulsory recruitment or credential collection.

citations.quote: it is possible to earn Ethereum even without referring anyone
stored in their personal Ethereum wallet, which they control the private keys.
deposit enough Ethereum to register and then activate the amount of levels that you want, one by one.

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Personal recruitment and surrendered keys are not necessary to identify the mechanism being promoted. The speaker says each level is purchased, payments come from the first four positions beneath a participant, and the fifth reopens the level. The pitch also links earnings to partners upgrading and spillover. The defense's own no-referral quote does not turn that purchased-position payment structure into an ordinary reward promotion.

citations.quote: Each level you purchase is four times the value of the previous one and it generates twice the income as well.
you get 100% of the payments to your Ethereum wallet from spot 1, 2, 3 and 4. The fifth spot reopens the level again.
you will not miss any income from partners upgrading before you or linear spillover.
